Micron Proposed Project
Micron New York Semiconductor Manufacturing LLC (Micron) proposes to construct and operate a semiconductor manufacturing facility at the 1,400-acre White Pine Commerce Park located at 5171 Route 31 in the town of Clay, Onondaga County. Micron proposes to construct four fabrication buildings (commonly referred to as ‘fabs’), associated support facilities, stormwater management areas, driveways, parking lots, a childcare facility on a separate parcel on the east side of Caughdenoy Road, and a rail spur on a separate property on the west side of Caughdenoy Road.
The fabs would be built sequentially from west to east which would result in continuous construction activity on the Micron Campus from 2025 to 2041.
